reviews.comment: Very boring class but he makes it less so. Every class he will give a case history which is super interesting. Very well organized and good lectures, he really knows what he is talking about and is passionate. Homework is optional but each homework is 1% extra credit added to your final grade. Great prof

You can tell he's very passionate about geotech and the case studies he does in class are very interesting. A lot of the learning happens outside of class through homework and lab. Course material was not high priority until towards the end of the semester. Very exam heavy but the exams are fair and he gives bonus points on the overall grade.

This guy knows his stuff and is passionate about it. He even wrote a book about it. Homework was for extra credit where solutions were in the book. His lectures were really good and quite interesting. I really like it when professors WRITE ON THE BOARD instead of scrolling through a powerpoint. Must memorize the equations!
